top_choice_rationale: P001 is a falsifiable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald magic angle) followed by experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, now reproduced widely, with a clean three-name split across prediction and discovery. A citation limited to flat bands and observed phases avoids the unsettled pairing mechanism; the eight-year record and omission of Cao and parallel groups are real costs but do not outweigh the strength of the chain. P003 is the lower-risk, more mature alternative but has the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan attribution problem and a 2016 topology overlap; P002 has the cleanest credit but is a measurement capability close to the 2005 and 2012 prizes; P004 overlaps the 2012 prize and is less decisive as a discovery. An award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no credited name on P001-P004 is a documented connection
